hookups.source: https://www.elkrivercampandrv.com/amenities ('Full Hookups: 50 AMP; 30 AMP; 120 Volt Power; City Water; Sewer Hookup', 'Partial Hookups: 50 AMP Power and Water Only or Power Only'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two parks, Little Buffalo and Bear Run, each with full (power, water, sewer) and partial (power + water, or power only) hookup sites. The operator says all sites are pull-through and take RVs of any size.

sites.source: https://www.elkrivercampandrv.com/amenities ('All Sites Are Pull Through', 'All Sites Accommodate RVs Of Any Size') + https://www.elkrivercampandrv.com/about-the-park ('It includes two parks: Little Buffalo and Bear Run'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve by phone, (303) 807-5209; 'Reservations are encouraged but not required.'

booking.source: https://www.elkrivercampandrv.com/payment-and-reservations ('Call (303) 807-5209 For Reservations. Reservations are encouraged but not required'), read 2026-10-21

note: Private riverfront RV park on the Elk River at Gassaway (Braxton Co), off I-79 Exit 62, in two parks (Little Buffalo and Bear Run); on-site boat launch (Elk River Water Trail). Some RV sites sit directly on the river. (Horse-friendly but not an equestrian campground.) --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: 50-amp full and partial hookups, phone reservations (encouraged, not required); added all sites pull-through. Fees ($15-35) left as recorded but undated. Note trimmed of the hookup/site/rating/booking text the fields now carry.
flags: Website looks compromised: the homepage https://www.elkrivercampandrv.com/ carries an injected block of about 900 unrelated spam domains (amareshotel.com, ion-sbobet88.id, ...) under the park content, read 2026-10-21. The park pages themselves still read as the operator's.

Rate undated: the operator's only price is 'Site Prices: $15.00 to $35.00 Per Night, Based Upon: Location, Availability, Weekends, and Holidays' with no year; it needs a 2024+ date under the rate rule. Under the US$50 gate either way. Family has not stayed here.
